title: The 3-Second Prayer for Anxiety
script: Anxiety spike? Whisper this 3-second prayer. Breathe in, Father, I’m here. Breathe out, I give this to You. That’s Philippians 4:6-7 in motion: bring your request, add thanksgiving, and God’s peace guards your heart and mind. When fear surges, don’t argue with it. Redirect it. Name the thing, thank God He’s near, release it on the exhale. Job email? Father, I’m here… I give this to You. Doctor call? Father, I’m here… I give this to You. Do it three times. Feel your shoulders drop. His peace isn’t a feeling you chase. It’s a guard He sends. Save this for later waves.

title: Philippians 4 Peace, In 3 Seconds
hook: If you’re feeling anxious, watch this.
script: If you’re feeling anxious, watch this. In three seconds, you can interrupt the spiral. Breathe in, Father, I’m here. Breathe out, I give this to You. Philippians 4 says don’t be anxious, but pray with thanksgiving, and God’s peace will guard your heart and mind. Here’s why it helps: the slow breath tells your body you’re safe; the prayer tells your mind who’s in control; thanksgiving shifts your focus from threat to Presence. Try it with what worries you right now. Name it, thank Him for being near, release it. Repeat as often as needed. Peace meets you in the pause.

title: Breathe This Prayer When Fear Hits
hook: You need to hear this today.
script: You need to hear this today. Peace can start in three seconds. Breathe in, Father, I’m here. Breathe out, I give this to You. That tiny prayer is Philippians 4 in real life: present your request with thanks, and God’s peace stands guard over your heart and mind. Watch how it fits your day. The unread email ding. Father, I’m here… I give this to You. The what-ifs at 2 a.m. Father, I’m here… I give this to You. The awkward silence in a room. Father, I’m here… I give this to You. If the wave returns, so do you. Three seconds. One prayer. A faithful God.
